v: pu॰ ud + Pala--GaY । 1 ullamPe 2 UrdDvatovisaraRe ca
m: उत्-फाल m. a spring, jump, leap
a: उत्फालः — 1 A jump, spring, leaping up; rapid motion; Mk. 6. --2 Shuffling of feet. --3 The jumping attitude.

m: उत्-फण mfn. having an expanded hood (as a snake).
उत्-√ फल् (उद्-√ फल्) P. -फलति, to spring open, burst, expand; to jump out, Bālar. : Caus. -फालयति, to open, open wide (the eyes), MBh.
a: उत्फल् — {c1c} P. 1 To spring, leap. --2 To part asunder, expand, open (as a flower). --Caus. To open, cause to expand.

m: उत्-फुलिङ्ग (for उत्-स्फुलिङ्ग) mfn. emitting sparks, sparkling.

s: tri, (utPalatIti । ut + Pal + kta । AditaScetIqaBAvaH utPullasaMPullayorupasaMKyAnamiti nizWAtasya laH .) praPullaH । vikasitaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, kirAte । (“utPullakamalaparAgajanyAdudDUtaH sarasijasamBavaH parAgaH” । spItaH । vardDitaH । (yaTA, vizRupurARe । 1 । 9 । 13 ॥ “harzotPullakapolena na cApi SirasA DftA” । AnandAdinA visPAritaH । yaTA, rAmAyaRe ॥ “avasTitEH samIpasTEstrAsAdutPullalocanEH” .) strIRAM karaRam । uttAnam । iti medinI ॥
v: tri॰ ud + Pala--kta ni॰ । 1 vikaSite dalAnAmanyonyaviSlezeRa prakASite “utPullanIlanalinodara tulyaBAsaH” mAGaH । 2 ucAne tri॰ 3 strIRAM guptendriye na॰ medi॰ ।
m: उत्-फुल्ल mfn. (Kāty. on Pāṇ. viii, 2, 55) blown (as a flower), Kir.; Kathās.; Śiś.
wide open (as the eyes), R.; Pañcat.; Hit. &c.
swollen, increased in bulk, bloated, puffed up, Kathās.; Bālar.; Śārṅg.
looking at with insolence, insolent, impudent, Pat.
उत्-फुल्ल n. a kind of coitus, L.
a: उत्फुल्ल — p. p. [उद्-फल्-क्त] 1 Opened, full blown (as flowers); उत्फुल्लनीलनलिनोदरतुल्यभासः Śi. 11. 36. --2 Widely opened, expanded, dilated (eyes); विस्मय ˚नयनः Pt. 1. --3 Swollen, increased in bulk. --4 Sleeping supinely or on the back; cf. उत्तान. --ल्लं 1 The female organ of generation (स्त्रीकरणं). --2 A kind of coitus.
